analysis.prior: Independent family/configuration Jeffreys Beta(.5,.5) frequencies and Dirichlet(.25,.25,.25,.25) severity bands. Matched contrasts use joint four-outcome Dirichlet(.25,.25,.25,.25) priors, preserving Beta margins.
analysis.scope: Six equally weighted targeted harder challenge families; observed cases and synthetic dollars, not production traffic. Previous 48-case evidence is development evidence and is not pooled with this study.
analysis.uncertainty: Marginal Bayesian intervals depend on the stated priors/model and equal family weights. Frequency exact upper bounds allocate 5% over 96 cells. Paired frequency contrast intervals allocate a separate 5% over 192 family/comparison contrasts (768 one-sided endpoints). They require a complete fixed batch, fixed policies and IID pairs within family. Two additional separate 5% families cover 32 arm/stream conditional-dollar sequences and 32 paired-dollar sequences. Together these four frequentist families are not a joint 95% guarantee (union bound at least 80%). Missing responses remain unresolved, excluded from financial estimates and counted as task errors.
analysis.memory_interpretation: Raw to selected changes retrieval selection, representation and the usage contract jointly. Selected to grounded adds deterministic calculations from visible connector records. That increment is computational support, not a database-memory-only effect. Context length, stochastic model responses and extra critic compute are not independently controlled.
